name: Blend In
description: Walks, spots and city guides from the people who live there.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string, including the database name.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The account with this email becomes the admin.

SEED_DEMO.description: Add the Dutch demo cities when the database is empty.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Stripe secret key. Leave empty for demo payments.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret of the Stripe webhook pointing at /stripe/webhook.

TILE_URL.description: Map tile URL template, e.g. from MapTiler or Stadia Maps.

TILE_ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution required by your tile provider.
